`final class GlConstants`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.binding` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlConstants.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/binding/GlConstants.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The OpenGL enum values that the OpenGL module passes to its binding, named after the OpenGL constants without their `GL_` prefix.

## Description

They let [`IGlBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/iglbinding/) take plain `int` values, so that base-opengl compiles against no LWJGL version.
A binding passes them to OpenGL unchanged.

## Learn more

- [base-opengl](/build/base-modules/opengl/)

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
